intent.goal: Exercise support capabilities, managed tools, CLI hints, context pointers, downstream checks, and supervisor authority-boundary/resume surfaces.

The handoff truthfully distinguishes live pauses from scripted resume surfaces; it must not invent a human pause if the run did not pause.
